title: Addressing the Business analyst
description: How to write for a reader acting as Business analyst. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `business-analyst` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Requirement-shaped: the need, the constraint, the acceptance condition
rules.description: Requirement-shaped: the need, the constraint, the acceptance condition. Ambiguity named rather than resolved by assumption.

source.quote: Turns stated needs into requirements others can build against. Works in the gap between what a stakeholder said and what the system can do, and is the one who notices when those differ.
